stages.effectText: Increases SP recovery rate by +0.25/second while above 80% HP

When deployed, recovers 6% HP whenever an allied Operator consumes ammo; in addition, there is a 30% chance to bombard the enemies within that Operator's Attack Range, dealing 165% of Exusiai the New Covenant's ATK as Physical splash damage
